name: rctest
description: Check whether a connected Betaflight FC is receiving live RC input from its receiver. Samples MSP_RC for ~3s, prints per-channel last/min/max/jitter (with switch position + throttle annotations), reads MSP_STATUS_EX arming-disable flags to surface FAILSAFE/RX_FAILSAFE/BOXFAILSAFE, and renders a verdict (LIVE vs no-input).
